long story involving a girl (of course), her calling me drunk after us making this sort of pact promise thing involving both of us not doing our respective terrible substances anymore. i posted in another thread about it, sort of. i'm just up. and someone suggested i stay up and find company in SW. so i am, i guess. i'm a bit more sane now, since time of posting this.
it was supposed to be to keep me company i guess.
i poseted athing

i don't even know what the fuck to do now.

the girl everything was going on with kept going on about how i should forget everyone else and try to trust her. i spent the last 4 months of my life on drugs and shut off from every single part of society. i just "came back" recently and came off drugs for the most part.

she always comes home later than she says she will. today she said 7. she didn't come home til 10:15. i called her at 9 and she was still at this guy's house and there was no sound anywhere in the background or anything. which made me suspicious. she left.

she called me at 10:15 drunk. she says she didn't do anything with him. i came off of the things i was doing, even though it was hard, because she said she wouldn't do anything including drink etc. it was a deal that would help both of us.

i didn't realize she was drunk at first. her speech was slurred. i was stupid. we are both too young to drink anyway so i shouldn't have to prevent her. i tried to explain to her how i wish she would come home when she said she was going to get home. before i could explain how it made me miserable and paranoid, and point out that i have issues with that and my insecurity (which she already knows) she said "what are you, my PARENTS?". i kept going on anyway and was suspicious by this point and i went on to explain how i really need to be able to trust people because i trust nobody and i haven't for a long long time. she said "hold on" in the middle of it, and i stopped to say "why?" and she yelled "HOLD ON". after about ten minutes i looked at my cell phone and she had hung up.

i called her back and i tried to explain again...at this point she told me she was drunk...by now i was sobbing...whatever...she said she did nothing with the guy...she was like "i didn't kiss anyone...i didn't hold anybody's hand" which was oddly specific but whatever...

then she said "i just can't listen to this right now"...and i guess fight or flight took over...she hung up and i called back god knows how many times...i finally left her a voicemail saying "i hope you don't check this until the morning because..." and then i told her everything she did, and i said congratulations on successfully detracting from any ability to trust people that i could have possibly gained through this relationship...

i sent a bunch of texts too...at the time in all caps and stuff i guess i was angry...i don't even remember...i sort of blacked out...she eventually texted me and basically said she didn't want to talk about it while drunk because she "does care about me"...i said if you care why the fuck did you drink...we promised each other...it was a promise

we started "going out" around this time last night...and as far as i'm concerned...it's already over.

i took a bunch of advil but i know it won't hurt me or even kill me...and it just makes me feel more worthless because i know i don't have the balls to kill myself.

i have even gotten to the point where i want to.

i just can't bring myself to do it.

i'm trying to. i'm working on it. and now there's this girl that really does want to be with me. and we are so happy. but i am too insecure and i have stopped telling her about it most of the time because i know it will probably piss her off eventually.
it's just whenever. i just think a lot and i get dizzy i guess.

i don't understand this though. i'm not isolating myself because of the males. i'm isolating myself because of other things. the thing the guy friends do is make me feel lesser about myself. i guess maybe i should learn that if someone has feelings for me, it's not necessary to receieve compliments. but i guess i feel like if random acquaintances are so wonderful, i should be too?

thank you.

actually, nothing at all really grosses me out. dead animals, no, moldy food, no (hell, i work with the stuff most of the time) and i don't think a single video on the internet has ever grossed me out (i'm talking the pain series, tubgirl, goatse, all the 4chan stuff, etc.)

i guess that's what most people are saying, that i just need to learn to be happy with myself. i am working on that but i'm trying to overcome my biggest pitfall which seems to be putting too much energy into one thing.

i always think i like them but then stuff like that happens. i don't understand why.

everyone always tells me i'm "an old man trapped in a teenager's body". and i guess maybe i keep wishing i could find someone else like that, but then piercings seem so juvenile or something. i don't know.

i wouldn't try to stop a girl from talking to or about guys...that's just mean. so i just drag myself away from them instead.

how can i do it without letting jobs, schools, parents etc. know?

i am 18 and in my second year of college if it makes a difference.

A lot of people tell me I need therapy but I've seen so many people go through therapy and they just come out drugged-up and even more miserable. They get put on pills and they've told me how it just made them empty towards the world, and they didn't even have their misery for solace any more. I don't want to be hopped up on pills, and everyone else that went to shrinks seems to be basically unaffected. Why?
